_note: Domain events and their subscriber scripts. Lifecycle wiring lives in .claude/settings.json; this file documents intent. Scripts read their payload via _hooklib.load_payload(), so both Claude Code (stdin) and tools/run_hook.py (HOOK_PAYLOAD) work. Pruned from 25 hooks across 13 events to 9 across 7 on 2026-08-02: a hook survives only if it DENIES something irreversible, ACTS, or is a one-line INFORM that costs nothing. See LOG.md 2026-08-02 21:10.

session-start.description: At session start; loads the knowledge docs into session context

pre-run.description: Before work starts on a turn; suggests the process skill matching the request

post-run.description: After a turn completes; snapshots recovery state, then commits the turn as a wip checkpoint if five artefact gates pass

pre-commit.description: Before a git commit/push finalizes; refuses credentials and protected-branch commits

pre-edit.description: Before a file write; refuses generated, vendored and lockfile targets

pre-deploy.description: Before a cloud-CLI command; allowlist-first free-tier spend guard

on-artifact-create.description: After a hook script is edited; demands it be fired against a real payload before being trusted
